title: A garland of grey hair
html_source: This alludes to the swimming priest which Stephen came across in Telemachus. He is imagining himself as this priest.

anchor.prefix: aces, Temple, Buck Mulligan, Foxy Campbell, Lanternjaws. Abbas father, furious dean, what offence laid 1961#39fire to their brains? Paff! Descende, calve, ut ne nimium decalveris.
anchor.suffix: on his comminated head see him me clambering down to the footpace (descende!), clutching a monstrance, basiliskeyed. Get down, bald poll! A choir gives back menace and echo, assis
